Before running this script, run the requirements script that contrains functions necessary to read the HEKA files. 
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

These are the necessary packages you will need.  
```{r}
# Required libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(signal)
library(PatchR)
library(minpack.lm)
library(openxlsx)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(forcats)
library(grid)
```

```{r}
save <- here("Physiology", "Physiology Script")
dir.create(save, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tracker_path <- here("data", "rawdata.xlsx")

tracker <- read_excel(
  tracker_path,
  sheet = "rawphysiology"
)
```

This is for adding columns into your excel tracker and creating the necessary file directory. 
```{r}
# Ensure columns exist before processing
cols_to_add <- c("classification", "transient_sustained", "on_peak","on_peak_post", "off_peak","off_peak_post","on_fp_index", "off_fp_index", "on_baseline", "off_baseline", "on_latency_to_peak", "off_latency_to_peak","peakdiameter", "os_index","os_plot_peak", "contrast_plot_peak", "dsi_on", "dsi_off")

for (col in cols_to_add) {
  if (!col %in% names(tracker)) tracker[[col]] <- NA
}

base <- here("Physiology", "Physiology Script", "graphs")
dir.create(base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_paths <- list(
  "ON-Transient"      = file.path(base, "lightstep-ON-Transient"),
  "ON-Sustained"      = file.path(base, "lightstep-ON-Sustained"),
  "OFF-Transient"     = file.path(base, "lightstep-OFF-Transient"),
  "OFF-Sustained"     = file.path(base, "lightstep-OFF-Sustained"),
  "ON-OFF-Transient"  = file.path(base, "lightstep_ON-OFF-Transient"),
  "ON-OFF-Sustained"  = file.path(base, "lightstep-ON-OFF-Sustained"),
  "NULL"  = file.path(base, "NULL"),
  "lightstep_rds" = file.path(base, "lightstep_histograms_rds"),
  "varieddiameter" = file.path (base, "varieddiameter"),
  "varieddiameter_group" = file.path (base, "varieddiameter_group"),
  "osindex" = file.path (base, "osindex"),
  "contrast"= file.path (base, "contrast"),
  "ds"= file.path(base, "ds"),
  "varieddiameter_rds" = file.path(base, "varieddiameter_rds"),
  "lightstep_stepwise_overlays" = file.path(base, "lightstep_stepwise_overlays"),
  "summary" = file.path(base, "summaryplots"),
  "stats" = file.path(base, "stats"),
  "featureselectivity" = file.path(base, "featureselectivity_stats")
)

lapply(save_paths, dir.create, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Begin processing
all_histograms <- list()
```



```{r}

baseline_window <- c(0, 1)

peak_window <- c(2.1, 2.9)
post_window <- c(3.1, 3.9)
final_window <- c(2.5, 2.99)

polarity_ratio_threshold <- 0.35
FP_TH <- 0.15
```

This chunk will process the light step stimuli and determine the cell's polarity (ON, OFF, ON/OFF) and kinetics (transient, sustained). 1/21/26 nl
```{r}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(tracker))) {
  
  row <- tracker[i, ]
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Skip cells already classified
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (!is.na(row$classification) && row$classification != "") {
    message(
      "Skipping ",
      row$file,
      " - classification already exists (",
      row$classification,
      ")"
    )
    next
  }
  
  
  # Skip rows without file or experiment number
  if (is.na(row$file) || is.na(row$e)) {
    next
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # File information
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  data_file <- here(
    "Physiology",
    "datfiles",
    row$file
  )
  
  data_filename <- extract_filename(data_file)
  experiment_number <- as.numeric(row$e)
  
  series_list_lightstep_ON  <- to_numeric_vector(row$on)
  series_list_lightstep_OFF <- to_numeric_vector(row$off)
  
  message(
    "Processing ",
    data_filename,
    " Experiment ",
    experiment_number
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SPIKE FREQUENCY EXTRACTION
  # ==========================================================
  
  all_spike_frequencies_ON <- if (!is.null(series_list_lightstep_ON)) {
    process_series(series_list_lightstep_ON)
  } else {
    list()
  }
  
  all_spike_frequencies_OFF <- if (!is.null(series_list_lightstep_OFF)) {
    process_series(series_list_lightstep_OFF)
  } else {
    list()
  }
  
  
  combined_spike_frequency_df_ON <- if (
    length(all_spike_frequencies_ON) > 0
  ) {
    combine_frequencies(
      all_spike_frequencies_ON,
      c1
    )
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
  
  
  combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF <- if (
    length(all_spike_frequencies_OFF) > 0
  ) {
    combine_frequencies(
      all_spike_frequencies_OFF,
      c2
    )
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
  
  
  # Skip if neither condition produced usable data
  if (
    nrow(combined_spike_frequency_df_ON) == 0 &&
    nrow(combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF) == 0
  ) {
    message(
      "Skipping ",
      data_filename,
      " - no spike data for ON or OFF"
    )
    next
  }
  
  
  final_spike_frequency_df <- bind_rows(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_ON,
    combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # ON METRICS
  # ==========================================================
  
  on_baseline <- get_mean_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_ON,
    baseline_window
  )
  
  on_peak <- get_peak_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_ON,
    peak_window
  )
  
  on_peak_post <- get_peak_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_ON,
    post_window
  )
  
  on_final <- get_mean_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_ON,
    final_window
  )
  
  on_fp_index <- get_fp_index(
    baseline = on_baseline,
    peak = on_peak,
    final = on_final
  )
  
  on_latency_to_peak <- if (
    nrow(combined_spike_frequency_df_ON) > 0
  ) {
    latency_to_response(
      combined_spike_frequency_df_ON,
      t0 = 2,
      baseline_window = baseline_window,
      k = 2,
      consecutive_bins = 2
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # OFF METRICS
  # ==========================================================
  
  off_baseline <- get_mean_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF,
    baseline_window
  )
  
  off_peak <- get_peak_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF,
    peak_window
  )
  
  off_peak_post <- get_peak_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF,
    post_window
  )
  
  off_final <- get_mean_frequency(
    combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF,
    final_window
  )
  
  off_fp_index <- get_fp_index(
    baseline = off_baseline,
    peak = off_peak,
    final = off_final
  )
  
  off_latency_to_peak <- if (
    nrow(combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF) > 0
  ) {
    latency_to_response(
      combined_spike_frequency_df_OFF,
      t0 = 2,
      baseline_window = baseline_window,
      k = 2,
      consecutive_bins = 2
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # WINDOW EVIDENCE
  # ==========================================================
  
  on_win_ON   <- fires(on_peak, on_baseline)
  on_win_OFF  <- fires(on_peak_post, on_baseline)
  
  off_win_OFF <- fires(off_peak, off_baseline)
  off_win_ON  <- fires(off_peak_post, off_baseline)
  
  
  on_fires  <- on_win_ON || off_win_ON
  off_fires <- off_win_OFF || on_win_OFF
  
  
  # Baseline-subtracted amplitudes
  amp_on_ON   <- amp(on_peak, on_baseline)
  amp_on_OFF  <- amp(on_peak_post, on_baseline)
  
  amp_off_OFF <- amp(off_peak, off_baseline)
  amp_off_ON  <- amp(off_peak_post, off_baseline)
  
  
  # Strongest valid ON evidence
  on_amp_bs <- max(
    if (on_win_ON)  amp_on_ON  else 0,
    if (off_win_ON) amp_off_ON else 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  
  # Strongest valid OFF evidence
  off_amp_bs <- max(
    if (off_win_OFF) amp_off_OFF else 0,
    if (on_win_OFF)  amp_on_OFF  else 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # POLARITY CLASSIFICATION
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (on_fires && off_fires) {
    
    ratio <- min(on_amp_bs, off_amp_bs) /
      max(on_amp_bs, off_amp_bs)
    
    if (ratio >= polarity_ratio_threshold) {
      classification <- "ON-OFF"
      
    } else if (on_amp_bs > off_amp_bs) {
      classification <- "ON"
      
    } else {
      classification <- "OFF"
    }
    
  } else if (on_fires) {
    
    classification <- "ON"
    
  } else if (off_fires) {
    
    classification <- "OFF"
    
  } else {
    
    classification <- "NULL"
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Opposite-window overrides
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (
    classification == "ON" &&
    off_win_OFF
  ) {
    classification <- "ON-OFF"
  }
  
  if (
    classification == "OFF" &&
    on_win_ON
  ) {
    classification <- "ON-OFF"
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # CHECK REQUIRED FP INDEX
  # ==========================================================
  
  missing_required_fp <- dplyr::case_when(
    classification == "ON" ~
      is.na(on_fp_index),
    
    classification == "OFF" ~
      is.na(off_fp_index),
    
    classification == "ON-OFF" ~
      is.na(on_fp_index) & is.na(off_fp_index),
    
    TRUE ~ FALSE
  )
  
  
  if (missing_required_fp) {
    classification <- "NULL"
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # TRANSIENT / SUSTAINED CLASSIFICATION
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (classification == "ON") {
    
    transient_sustained <- ifelse(
      on_fp_index > FP_TH,
      "Sustained",
      "Transient"
    )
    
  } else if (classification == "OFF") {
    
    transient_sustained <- ifelse(
      off_fp_index > FP_TH,
      "Sustained",
      "Transient"
    )
    
  } else if (classification == "ON-OFF") {
    
    max_fp_index <- max(
      on_fp_index,
      off_fp_index,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    transient_sustained <- ifelse(
      max_fp_index > FP_TH,
      "Sustained",
      "Transient"
    )
    
  } else {
    
    transient_sustained <- "NULL"
  }
  

  
  tracker$classification[i] <- classification
  tracker$transient_sustained[i] <- transient_sustained
  
  tracker$on_peak[i] <- on_peak
  tracker$on_peak_post[i] <- on_peak_post
  
  tracker$off_peak[i] <- off_peak
  tracker$off_peak_post[i] <- off_peak_post
  
  tracker$on_baseline[i] <- on_baseline
  tracker$off_baseline[i] <- off_baseline
  
  tracker$on_fp_index[i] <- on_fp_index
  tracker$off_fp_index[i] <- off_fp_index
  
  tracker$on_latency_to_peak[i] <- on_latency_to_peak
  tracker$off_latency_to_peak[i] <- off_latency_to_peak
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # GROUP LABEL
  # ==========================================================
  
  group_key <- if (classification == "NULL") {
    "NULL"
  } else {
    paste(
      classification,
      transient_sustained,
      sep = "-"
    )
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # OUTPUT DIRECTORY
  # ==========================================================
  
  classification_dir <- save_paths[[group_key]]
  
  dir.create(
    classification_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SAVE HISTOGRAM DATA
  # ==========================================================
  
  final_spike_frequency_df$cell_id <- paste(
    data_filename,
    paste0("E", experiment_number)
  )
  
  final_spike_frequency_df$group <- group_key
  
  all_histograms[[length(all_histograms) + 1]] <-
    final_spike_frequency_df
  
  
  saveRDS(
    final_spike_frequency_df,
    file = file.path(
      save_paths[["lightstep_rds"]],
      paste0(
        data_filename,
        "_E",
        experiment_number,
        "_hist.rds"
      )
    )
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SPIKE FREQUENCY PLOT
  # ==========================================================
  
  max_spike_freq <- max(
    final_spike_frequency_df$Average_Spike_Frequency,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  ylim_upper <- max_spike_freq * 1.25
  
  rect_ymax <- ylim_upper * 0.85
  rect_height <- ylim_upper * 0.01
  
  
  plot <- ggplot() +
    
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = 2,
        xmax = 3,
        ymin = rect_ymax,
        ymax = rect_ymax + rect_height
      ),
      fill = "black"
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 2.5,
      y = rect_ymax,
      label = "light step",
      vjust = -1,
      size = 5
    ) +
    
    geom_col(
      data = final_spike_frequency_df,
      aes(
        x = Bin_start_time,
        y = Average_Spike_Frequency,
        fill = Condition,
        group = Condition
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.05),
      width = 0.05
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(c1, c2)
    ) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Time (s)",
      y = "Spike frequency (spikes/s)"
    ) +
    
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, 4.75),
      ylim = c(0, ylim_upper),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    
    theme_classic() +
    
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  
  outfile <- file.path(
    classification_dir,
    paste0(
      "spike_freq_",
      data_filename,
      "_E",
      experiment_number,
      ".png"
    )
  )
  
  
  ggsave(
    filename = outfile,
    plot = plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  
  message("SAVED: ", outfile)
}


# ============================================================
# SAVE TRACKER
# ============================================================

# Load existing workbook
wb <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(tracker_path)

# Write updated tracker data
openxlsx::writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "rawphysiology",
  x = tracker
)

# Save workbook
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  tracker_path,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# FINAL GROUP COUNTS
# ============================================================

tracker <- tracker %>%
  mutate(
    group = if_else(
      is.na(classification) |
        classification == "NULL",
      "NULL",
      paste(
        classification,
        transient_sustained,
        sep = "-"
      )
    )
  )


group_counts <- tracker %>%
  count(
    group,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_cells)
  )

group_counts
```

This will plot the light step just for the c1 channel which for this is the ON step stimuli. It will do both individual plots, layered plots, and a plot that has all the traces from each group. 1/21/26 nl
```{r}
save_dir <- save_paths[["lightstep_stepwise_overlays"]]

dir.create(
  save_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

tracker <- tracker %>%
  mutate(
    classification = trimws(classification),
    transient_sustained = trimws(transient_sustained),

    group = case_when(
      is.na(classification) | classification == "NULL" ~ NA_character_,
      is.na(transient_sustained) | transient_sustained == "NULL" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ paste(classification, transient_sustained, sep = "-")
    ),

    cell_id = paste(
      extract_filename(
        file.path(
          here("Physiology", "datfiles"),
          file
        )
      ),
      paste0("E", e)
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# ONE CLASSIFICATION PER CELL
# ============================================================

tracker_groups <- tracker %>%
  select(
    cell_id,
    group
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    cell_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# ============================================================
# LOAD SAVED LIGHT-STEP HISTOGRAMS
# ============================================================

rds_files <- list.files(
  save_paths[["lightstep_rds"]],
  pattern = "_hist\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(rds_files) == 0) {
  stop("No light-step RDS files found.")
}

all_histograms <- lapply(
  rds_files,
  readRDS
)

pooled_data <- bind_rows(
  all_histograms
)


# Remove old group assignments stored in RDS files.
# The tracker is treated as the current source of truth.

pooled_data <- pooled_data %>%
  select(
    -any_of("group")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    tracker_groups,
    by = "cell_id"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    cell_id,
    Bin_start_time,
    Condition,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# ============================================================
# SELECT ON CONDITION
# ============================================================

pooled_data_on <- pooled_data %>%
  filter(
    Condition == "#3182bd"
  )


# ============================================================
# CELL COUNTS
# ============================================================

group_n <- pooled_data_on %>%
  distinct(
    cell_id,
    group
  ) %>%
  count(
    group,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group_label = paste0(
      group,
      " (n=",
      n_cells,
      ")"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# SUMMARY: MEAN ± SEM
# ============================================================

summary_histogram <- pooled_data_on %>%
  group_by(
    group,
    Bin_start_time
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_frequency = mean(
      Average_Spike_Frequency,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sd_frequency = sd(
      Average_Spike_Frequency,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_cells = n_distinct(
      cell_id
    ),

    sem = sd_frequency / sqrt(n_cells),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    group_n %>%
      select(
        group,
        group_label
      ),
    by = "group"
  )


# ============================================================
# FACTOR ORDER
# ============================================================

summary_histogram <- summary_histogram %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  )


label_order <- group_n %>%
  filter(
    group %in% group_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    group
  ) %>%
  pull(
    group_label
  )


summary_histogram <- summary_histogram %>%
  mutate(
    group_label = factor(
      group_label,
      levels = label_order
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# COLORS WITH N LABELS
# ============================================================

named_colors <- setNames(
  custom_colors[
    as.character(
      group_n$group[
        match(
          label_order,
          group_n$group_label
        )
      ]
    )
  ],
  label_order
)


# ============================================================
# MAIN GROUP AVERAGE PLOT
# ============================================================

spike_hist_plot <- ggplot(
  summary_histogram,
  aes(
    x = Bin_start_time,
    y = mean_frequency,
    color = group_label,
    fill = group_label
  )
) +

  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(
        mean_frequency - sem,
        0
      ),
      ymax = mean_frequency + sem
    ),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(2, 3),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 2:4
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = named_colors
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = named_colors
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(1.75, 4)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Spike frequency (Hz)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 30,
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.ticks.length = unit(
      0.4,
      "cm"
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 30,
      r = 10,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  )

spike_hist_plot


# ============================================================
# SAVE MAIN PLOT
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    save_dir,
    "ON_spike_hist_plot.pdf"
  ),
  plot = spike_hist_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)


# ============================================================
# STEPWISE OVERLAYS
# ============================================================

for (i in seq_along(group_order)) {

  included_groups <- group_order[
    seq_len(i)
  ]

  current_group <- group_order[i]


  included_data <- summary_histogram %>%
    filter(
      group %in% included_groups
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      is_current =
        as.character(group) ==
        current_group
    )


  step_plot <- ggplot(
    included_data,
    aes(
      x = Bin_start_time,
      y = mean_frequency,
      group = group
    )
  ) +

    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = pmax(
          mean_frequency - sem,
          0
        ),
        ymax = mean_frequency + sem,
        fill = group,
        alpha = ifelse(
          is_current,
          "current_ribbon",
          "past_ribbon"
        )
      ),
      color = NA
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(
        color = group,
        alpha = ifelse(
          is_current,
          "current_line",
          "past_line"
        )
      ),
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(2, 3),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = custom_colors
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = custom_colors
    ) +

    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(
        "current_ribbon" = 0.6,
        "past_ribbon" = 0.1,
        "current_line" = 1,
        "past_line" = 0.1
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(1.75, 4),
      ylim = c(0, 150)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Time (s)",
      y = "Spike frequency (Hz)"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      axis.text = element_text(
        size = 16,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 30,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(
        0.4,
        "cm"
      ),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 30,
        r = 10,
        b = 10,
        l = 10
      )
    )


  step_filename <- paste0(
    "ON_stepwise_",
    i,
    "_",
    gsub("-", "_", current_group),
    ".pdf"
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      save_dir,
      step_filename
    ),
    plot = step_plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 6
  )
}
```

This will plot the light step just for the c2 channel which for this is the OFF step stimuli. It will do both individual plots, layered plots, and a plot that has all the traces from each group. 1/21/26 nl 
```{r}
save_dir <- save_paths[["lightstep_stepwise_overlays"]]

dir.create(
  save_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

tracker <- tracker %>%
  mutate(
    classification = trimws(classification),
    transient_sustained = trimws(transient_sustained),

    group = case_when(
      is.na(classification) | classification == "NULL" ~ NA_character_,
      is.na(transient_sustained) | transient_sustained == "NULL" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ paste(classification, transient_sustained, sep = "-")
    ),

    cell_id = paste(
      extract_filename(
        file.path(
          here("Physiology", "datfiles"),
          file
        )
      ),
      paste0("E", e)
    )
  )


tracker_groups <- tracker %>%
  select(
    cell_id,
    group
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    cell_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# Load histogram traces
rds_files <- list.files(
  save_paths[["lightstep_rds"]],
  pattern = "_hist\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

all_histograms <- lapply(rds_files, readRDS)
pooled_data <- bind_rows(all_histograms)

if ("group" %in% names(pooled_data)) {
  pooled_data <- pooled_data %>% select(-group)
}

pooled_data <- pooled_data %>%
  select(-any_of("group")) %>%
  inner_join(tracker_groups, by = "cell_id") %>%
  distinct(cell_id, Bin_start_time, Condition, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ON-only data for ON plots
pooled_data_off <- pooled_data %>%
  filter(Condition == "black")

group_n <- pooled_data_off %>%
  distinct(cell_id, group) %>%
  count(group) %>%
  mutate(group_label = paste0(group, " (n=", n, ")"))

summary_histogram <- pooled_data_off %>%
  group_by(group, Bin_start_time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_frequency = mean(Average_Spike_Frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(Average_Spike_Frequency, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(group_n, by = "group")

# Set factor levels
summary_histogram$group <- factor(summary_histogram$group, levels = group_order)
summary_histogram$group_label <- factor(summary_histogram$group_label, levels = group_n$group_label[match(group_order, group_n$group)])

# build levels without NAs
lvl_vec <- unique(stats::na.omit(group_n$group_label[match(group_order, group_n$group)]))

# remove NA rows, then refactor
summary_histogram <- summary_histogram %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group_label)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_label = factor(group_label, levels = lvl_vec))

# Map colors to group labels with n
color_labels <- group_n$group_label[match(group_order, group_n$group)]
named_colors <- setNames(custom_colors[group_order], color_labels)

# Plot
spike_hist_plot <- ggplot(
  summary_histogram,
  aes(
    x = Bin_start_time,
    y = mean_frequency,
    color = group_label,
    fill = group_label
  )
) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_frequency - sem, ymax = mean_frequency + sem),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(1, 4),
  breaks = 1:4
)+
  scale_color_manual(values = named_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = named_colors) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Spike frequency (Hz)", title = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 30,
      r = 10,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

# Save the main plot
save_dir <- save_paths[["lightstep_stepwise_overlays"]]
ggsave(
  filename = "OFF_spike_hist_plot.pdf",
  plot = spike_hist_plot,
  path = save_dir,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Stepwise overlays
for (i in seq_along(group_order)) {
  included_groups <- group_order[1:i]
  current_group <- group_order[i]
  
  included_data <- summary_histogram %>%
    dplyr::filter(group %in% included_groups) %>%
    mutate(is_current = group == current_group)
  
  step_plot <- ggplot(included_data,
                      aes(x = Bin_start_time, y = mean_frequency, group = group)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_frequency - sem,
        ymax = mean_frequency + sem,
        fill = group,
        alpha = ifelse(is_current, "current_ribbon", "past_ribbon")
      ),
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(aes(
      color = group,
      alpha = ifelse(is_current, "current_line", "past_line")
    ), size = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(
        "current_ribbon" = 0.6,
        "past_ribbon" = 0.1,
        "current_line" = 1,
        "past_line" = 0.1
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 150)) +
    labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Spike frequency (Hz)", title = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 30,
        r = 10,
        b = 10,
        l = 10
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
  
  
  step_filename <- paste0("OFF_stepwise_", i, "_", gsub("-", "_", current_group), ".pdf")
  ggsave(
    step_filename,
    plot = step_plot,
    path = save_dir,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

individual_plots <- vector("list", length(group_order))
names(individual_plots) <- group_order


for (grp in group_order) {
```

This will analyze each sweep for the spike frequency, which corresponds with a varying spot size. In my stimuli there were two stimuli, small various diameter that ranged from 25-325um and then normal various diameter that is from 50-1200um. 1/21/26 nl 
```{r}
all_diameter_histograms <- list()

# Small diameter mapping
small_diameters <- c(325, 175, 225, 125, 250, 275, 75, 200, 25, 150, 100, 50, 0, 300)
names(small_diameters) <- paste0(1:14)

# Regular diameter mapping
diameters <- c(1000, 200, 900, 700, 400, 300, 1200, 50, 100, 600, 0, 800, 1100, 500)
names(diameters) <- paste0(1:14)


for (i in 1:nrow(tracker)) {
  row <- tracker[i, ]
  
  data_file <- file.path(
    here("Physiology", "datfiles"),
    row$file
  )
data_filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(data_file))
  experiment_number <- as.numeric(row$e)
  
  
  #skip if peakdiameter already exists
  if (!is.na(row$peakdiameter)) {
   message(paste("Skipping", row$file, "- peakdiameter already calculated."))
   next
  }
  
  data_filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(row$file))
  experiment_number <- as.numeric(row$e)
  plot_title <- paste("diameter_plot", data_filename, experiment_number, sep = "_")
  full_filename <- paste0(plot_title, ".png")
  plot_path <- file.path(save_paths[["varieddiameter"]], full_filename)
  
  if (file.exists(plot_path)) {
  message(paste("Skipping", row$file, "- diameter plot already exists."))
  next
  }
  
  if (is.na(row$file) || is.na(row$e))
    next
  
    data_file <- file.path(
      here("Physiology", "datfiles"),
      row$file
    )  
  # Set default classification if NA
  cell_class <- row$classification
  if (is.na(cell_class))
    cell_class <- "NULL"
  
  if (tolower(cell_class) == "null") {
    message(paste("Skipping", data_filename, "- classification is NULL."))
    next
  }
  
  # Determine which series to use
  series_ON <- parse_series(if (!is.na(row$vdsmallon))
    row$vdsmallon
    else
      row$vdon)
  series_OFF <- parse_series(if (!is.na(row$vdsmalloff))
    row$vdsmalloff
    else
      row$vdoff)
  
  if (is.null(series_ON) && is.null(series_OFF)) {
    message(paste("Skipping", data_filename, "- no vdon/vdoff data."))
    next
  }
  
  message(
    paste(
      "Processing",
      data_filename,
      "Experiment",
      experiment_number,
      "for varied diameter..."
    )
  )
  
  all_spike_frequencies <- list()
  
  if (cell_class == "ON" && !is.null(series_ON)) {
    for (series in series_ON) {
      all_spike_frequencies[[paste(series, "ON")]] <- process_series_vd(series, "ON")
    }
  } else if (cell_class == "OFF" && !is.null(series_OFF)) {
    for (series in series_OFF) {
      all_spike_frequencies[[paste(series, "OFF")]] <- process_series_vd(series, "OFF")
    }
  } else if (cell_class == "ON-OFF") {
    if (!is.null(series_ON)) {
      for (series in series_ON) {
        all_spike_frequencies[[paste(series, "ON")]] <- process_series_vd(series, "ON")
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(series_OFF)) {
      for (series in series_OFF) {
        all_spike_frequencies[[paste(series, "OFF")]] <- process_series_vd(series, "OFF")
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(all_spike_frequencies) == 0) {
    message(paste("No valid spike frequency data for", data_filename))
    next
  }
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(all_spike_frequencies) %>%
    group_by(Sweep, Response) %>%
    summarise(MeanFrequency = mean(AvgFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop')
  
  is_small <- !is.na(row$vdsmallon) || !is.na(row$vdsmalloff)
  diameters_used <- if (is_small)
    small_diameters
  else
    diameters
  
  diameter_mapping <- data.frame(Sweep = names(diameters_used),
                                 Diameter = as.character(diameters_used))
  combined_data <- left_join(diameter_mapping, combined_data, by = "Sweep")
  combined_data$Diameter <- as.numeric(combined_data$Diameter)
  
  valid_peaks <- combined_data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(MeanFrequency), !is.na(Diameter))
  
  if (nrow(valid_peaks) > 0) {
    peak_freq <- max(valid_peaks$MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE)
    peak_row <- valid_peaks %>% dplyr::filter(MeanFrequency == peak_freq) %>% dplyr::slice(1)
    tracker$peakdiameter[i] <- peak_row$Diameter
  }
  
  ordered_avg_frequencies <- combined_data %>% arrange(Diameter, Response)
  ordered_avg_frequencies$group <- paste(row$classification, row$transient_sustained, sep = "-")
  ordered_avg_frequencies$File <- row$file
  
  # Save .rds per cell
  rds_dir <- save_paths[["varieddiameter_rds"]]
  rds_filename <- paste0(
    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(row$file)),
    "_",
    experiment_number,
    "_diameter_hist.rds"
  )
  rds_path <- file.path(rds_dir, rds_filename)
  saveRDS(ordered_avg_frequencies, file = rds_path)
  
  
  if (!exists("all_diameter_histograms"))
    all_diameter_histograms <- list()
  all_diameter_histograms[[length(all_diameter_histograms) + 1]] <- ordered_avg_frequencies
  
  diameter_plot <- ggplot(ordered_avg_frequencies,
                          aes(
                            x = as.factor(Diameter),
                            y = MeanFrequency,
                            fill = Response
                          )) +
    geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      width = 0.5,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(c2, c1), na.translate = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Spot Diameter (µm)", y = "Spike frequency (spikes/s)", title = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "None",
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 30,
        r = 10,
        b = 10,
        l = 10
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(
      0,
      max(ordered_avg_frequencies$MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2
    ))
  
  print(diameter_plot)
  
  ggsave(
    full_filename,
    plot = diameter_plot,
    device = "png",
    path = save_paths[["varieddiameter"]],
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

# Load existing workbook
wb <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(tracker_path)

# Write updated tracker data
openxlsx::writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "rawphysiology",
  x = tracker
)

# Save workbook
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  tracker_path,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

This plots both a bar and line graph for the varied diameter stimuli. 1/21/26 nl 
```{r}
rds_files <- list.files(save_paths[["varieddiameter_rds"]], pattern = "_diameter_hist\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
all_diameter_histograms <- lapply(rds_files, readRDS)
pooled_diameter <- bind_rows(all_diameter_histograms)

custom_colors <- c(

)

# Set group plotting order

# Generate and save plots

      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
```

This plots orientation selectivity using the same calculation provided by Nath & Schwartz JNeuro 2016. 1/21/26 nl 
```{r}
for (i in 1:nrow(tracker)) {
  row <- tracker[i, ]
  
  data_file <- file.path(
    here("Physiology", "datfiles"),
    row$file
  )
  
  data_filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(data_file))
  experiment_number <- as.numeric(row$e)
  
  # Skip already-analyzed or invalid entries
  if (!is.na(tracker$os_index[i])) {
  message(paste("Skipping", tracker$file[i], "- os_index already calculated."))
  next
  }
  
  if (is.na(row$file) || is.na(row$e) || is.na(row$os))
    next
  
  classification <- ifelse(is.na(row$classification), "NULL", row$classification)
  if (tolower(classification) == "null") {
    message(paste("Skipping", row$file, "- classification is NULL."))
    next
  }
  
  series_list_os <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(as.character(row$os), ",")))
  all_frequencies <- list()
  
  for (series in series_list_os) {
    data <- ImportPRecording(
      data_file,
      experiment = experiment_number,
      series = series,
      traces = 1,
      encoding = getOption("encoding"),
      filetype = 'PatchMaster',
      verbose = TRUE
    )
    
    timepoints <- data@TimeTrace
    current_data_pA <- data@Data[["Imon-1"]] * 1e12
    colnames(current_data_pA) <- as.numeric(gsub("s|:", "", colnames(current_data_pA)))
    
    # Spike detection
    cutoff_high <- 0.2
    cutoff_low <- 700
    high_order <- 2
    low_order <- 4
    
    sweeps_data <- as.data.frame(current_data_pA) %>%
      mutate(Time = timepoints) %>%
      pivot_longer(-Time, names_to = "Sweep", values_to = "Current") %>%
      arrange(Sweep, Time) %>%
      group_by(Sweep) %>%
      group_modify( ~ {
        time <- .x$Time
        current <- .x$Current
        dt <- mean(diff(time))
        Fs <- 1 / dt
        b_high <- signal::butter(high_order, cutoff_high / (Fs / 2), type = "high")
        b_low <- signal::butter(low_order, cutoff_low / (Fs / 2), type = "low")
        filtered <- signal::filtfilt(b_low, signal::filtfilt(b_high, current))
        derivative <- c(NA, diff(filtered) / dt)
        threshold <- max(derivative, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5
        spike_indices <- which(derivative > threshold)
        refractory_samples <- round(0.002 / dt)
        valid_spike_indices <- if (length(spike_indices) > 0) {
          idx <- spike_indices[1]
          for (i in spike_indices[-1]) {
            if (i - tail(idx, 1) > refractory_samples) {
              idx <- c(idx, i)
            }
          }
          idx
        } else
          integer(0)
        .x$Is_spike <- FALSE
        .x$Is_spike[valid_spike_indices] <- TRUE
        return(.x)
      }) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # Spike frequency between 2.0–2.5s
    bin_size <- 0.05
    bins <- seq(from = 2.0, to = 2.5, by = bin_size)
    filtered_data <- sweeps_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(Is_spike, Time >= 2.0 & Time < 2.5) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Bin = cut(
        Time,
        breaks = bins,
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        right = FALSE
      )) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Sweep, Bin) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Frequency = Count / bin_size)
    
    average_frequencies <- filtered_data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Sweep) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(AvgFrequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
                       .groups = 'drop')
    
    all_frequencies[[as.character(series)]] <- average_frequencies
  }
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(all_frequencies) %>%
    group_by(Sweep) %>%
    summarise(
      MeanFrequency = mean(AvgFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
      SDFrequency = sd(AvgFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
      SEMFrequency = sd(AvgFrequency, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
    )
  
  # --- Map sweep numbers to directions ---
  angles <- c(210, 30, 180, 270, 330, 90, 240, 300, 60, 120, 0, 150)
  names(angles) <- paste0(1:12)
  combined_data$Angle <- as.numeric(angles[as.character(combined_data$Sweep)])
  
  # =========================
  # OSI (DSI-analog): |Σ R(θ) e^{2 i θ}| / Σ R(θ)
  # Preferred orientation: 0.5 * arg(Σ R(θ) e^{2 i θ})  (mod 180)
  # =========================
  
  # If tuning is too weak, mark OS as NULL and skip plot
  if (max(combined_data$MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE) < 5) {
    tracker$os_index[i] <- NA
    tracker$os_plot_peak[i] <- NA
    message("Skipping OSI + plot (<5 Hz): ", row$file)
    next
  }
  
  # Use 12 directions (like DSI) and treat them as angles θ
  angle_df <- combined_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Angle)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Angle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(R = mean(MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Angle)
  
  theta_rad <- angle_df$Angle * pi / 180
  R <- angle_df$R
  
  # Vector sum with doubled angles
  vec2 <- sum(R * exp(1i * 2 * theta_rad))
  osi <- abs(vec2) / sum(R)
  
  # Preferred orientation from half the phase (0..180), then map to [-90, 90] for plotting
  theta_pref_deg <- (Arg(vec2) * 180 / pi) / 2
  theta_pref_deg <- theta_pref_deg %% 180
  pref_canon <- ifelse(theta_pref_deg > 90, theta_pref_deg - 180, theta_pref_deg)
  
  tracker$os_index[i] <- osi
  tracker$os_plot_peak[i] <- as.numeric(pref_canon)
  
  
  # --- Collapse 180°-apart replicates to canonical orientation in [-90, 90] for plotting ---
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Orientation = ((Angle + 90) %% 180) - 90)    # {-90,-60,-30,0,30,60,90}
  
  # Average replicates (two angles per orientation) and compute SEM across the replicates
  ordered_avg_frequencies <- combined_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Orientation) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      MeanFrequency = mean(MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE),
      SEMFrequency  = sd(MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(MeanFrequency))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Orientation)
  
  # --- Plot on [-90, 90] as a LINE with SEM ribbon ---
  canon_order  <- c(-90, -60, -30, 0, 30, 60, 90)
  canon_labels <- c("-90", "-60", "-30", "0", "30", "60", "90")
  
  angles_plot <- ggplot(ordered_avg_frequencies,
                        aes(x = Orientation, y = MeanFrequency, group = 1)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = pmax(0, MeanFrequency - SEMFrequency),
        ymax = MeanFrequency + SEMFrequency
      ),
      fill = "black",
      alpha = 0.3,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(color = "black") +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = pref_canon,
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = canon_order,
                       labels = canon_labels,
                       limits = c(-90, 90)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(
      0,
      max(ordered_avg_frequencies$MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.25
    )) +
    labs(x = "Orientation (°)", y = "Spike frequency (spikes/s)", title = "Orientation Tuning") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.line    = element_line(color = "black")
    )
  
  plot_title    <- paste("angles_plot", data_filename, experiment_number, sep = "_")
  full_filename <- paste0(plot_title, ".png")
  ggsave(
    full_filename,
    plot = angles_plot,
    path = save_paths[["osindex"]],
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  # (Optional) keep tidy version for pooling later
  ordered_avg_frequencies$AngleLabel <- factor(ordered_avg_frequencies$Orientation,
                                               levels = canon_order,
                                               labels = canon_labels)
  ordered_avg_frequencies$group <- paste(row$classification, row$transient_sustained, sep = "-")
  ordered_avg_frequencies$File  <- row$file
  
  if (!exists("all_angles_histograms"))
    all_angles_histograms <- list()
  all_angles_histograms[[length(all_angles_histograms) + 1]] <- ordered_avg_frequencies
  
}

# Load existing workbook
wb <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(tracker_path)

# Write updated tracker data
openxlsx::writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "rawphysiology",
  x = tracker
)

# Save workbook
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  tracker_path,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

This is plotting the direction selectivity index using the formula from Duan & Sanes Cell 2014. 1/21/26 nl 
```{r}
if (!"is_DS_ON"  %in% colnames(tracker)) tracker$is_DS_ON  <- NA
if (!"is_DS_OFF" %in% colnames(tracker)) tracker$is_DS_OFF <- NA

# Define spike detection function
process_series <- function(series, response_type) {
  data <- ImportPRecording(
    data_file,
    experiment = experiment_number,
    series = series,
    traces = 1,
    encoding = getOption("encoding"),
    filetype = 'PatchMaster',
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  timepoints <- data@TimeTrace
  current_data_pA <- data@Data[["Imon-1"]] * 1e12
  colnames(current_data_pA) <- as.numeric(gsub("s|:", "", colnames(current_data_pA)))

  cutoff_high <- 0.2
  cutoff_low <- 700
  high_order <- 2
  low_order <- 4

  sweeps_data <- as.data.frame(current_data_pA) %>%
    mutate(Time = timepoints) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Time, names_to = "Sweep", values_to = "Current") %>%
    arrange(Sweep, Time) %>%
    group_by(Sweep) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      time <- .x$Time
      current <- .x$Current
      dt <- mean(diff(time))
      Fs <- 1 / dt
      b_high <- signal::butter(high_order, cutoff_high / (Fs / 2), type = "high")
      b_low <- signal::butter(low_order, cutoff_low / (Fs / 2), type = "low")
      filtered <- signal::filtfilt(b_low, signal::filtfilt(b_high, current))
      derivative <- c(NA, diff(filtered) / dt)
      threshold <- max(derivative, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5
      spike_indices <- which(derivative > threshold)
      refractory_samples <- round(0.002 / dt)
      valid_spike_indices <- if (length(spike_indices) > 0) {
        idx <- spike_indices[1]
        for (i in spike_indices[-1]) {
          if (i - tail(idx, 1) > refractory_samples) {
            idx <- c(idx, i)
          }
        }
        idx
      } else integer(0)
      .x$Is_spike <- FALSE
      .x$Is_spike[valid_spike_indices] <- TRUE
      return(.x)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  bin_size <- 0.05
  bins <- seq(from = 2, to = 3, by = bin_size)
  filtered_data <- sweeps_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Is_spike, Time >= 2 & Time < 3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Bin = cut(Time, breaks = bins, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sweep, Bin) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Frequency = Count / bin_size)

  average_frequencies <- filtered_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sweep) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(AvgFrequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Response = response_type)

  return(average_frequencies)
}

# Main analysis loop
for (i in 1:nrow(tracker)) {
  row <- tracker[i, ]

 data_file <- file.path(
  here("Physiology", "datfiles"),

)
 
  data_filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(data_file))

  if (is.na(tracker$file[i]) || is.na(tracker$e[i])) next

  if (is.na(row$classification) || tolower(row$classification) == "null") next

data_file <- file.path(
  here("Physiology", "datfiles"),
  row$file
)
  
  data_filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(data_file))
  experiment_number <- as.numeric(row$e)
  cell_class <- row$classification

  series_list_ds_ON <- parse_series(row$dson)
  series_list_ds_OFF <- parse_series(row$dsoff)

  angles <- c(210, 30, 180, 270, 330, 90, 240, 300, 60, 120, 0, 150)
  names(angles) <- paste0(1:12)

  for (response_type in c("ON", "OFF")) {
    # Skip if already analyzed
    if ((response_type == "ON" && !is.na(tracker$dsi_on[i])) ||
       (response_type == "OFF" && !is.na(tracker$dsi_off[i]))) next
    

    series_list <- if (response_type == "ON") series_list_ds_ON else series_list_ds_OFF
    if ((cell_class == response_type || cell_class == "ON-OFF") && length(series_list) > 0) {

      all_frequencies <- list()
      for (series in series_list) {
        all_frequencies[[as.character(series)]] <- process_series(series, response_type)
      }

      combined_data <- bind_rows(all_frequencies) %>%
        group_by(Sweep) %>%
        summarise(MeanFrequency = mean(AvgFrequency, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

      combined_data$Angle <- angles[as.character(combined_data$Sweep)]

      ordered_avg_frequencies <- combined_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(Angle)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(Angle)

      plot_angles <- unique(ordered_avg_frequencies$Angle)

      ############
      # --- Vector-sum DSI (Duan 2014-style) ---
# DSI = |Σ R(θ) e^{iθ}| / Σ R(θ)

theta_rad <- ordered_avg_frequencies$Angle * pi / 180
R <- ordered_avg_frequencies$MeanFrequency

vec <- sum(R * exp(1i * theta_rad))
DSI_value <- abs(vec) / sum(R)

pref_dir_deg <- (Arg(vec) * 180 / pi) %% 360


if (response_type == "ON")  tracker$dsi_on[i]  <- DSI_value
if (response_type == "OFF") tracker$dsi_off[i] <- DSI_value

# --- Direction selective cutoff (Duan 2014) ---
if (response_type == "ON") {
  tracker$is_DS_ON[i] <- !is.na(DSI_value) && DSI_value >= 0.33
}

if (response_type == "OFF") {
  tracker$is_DS_OFF[i] <- !is.na(DSI_value) && DSI_value >= 0.33
}


# Optional: store preferred direction if you have columns for it
if (response_type == "ON"  && "dsi_on_pref_dir"  %in% names(tracker)) tracker$dsi_on_pref_dir[i]  <- pref_dir_deg
if (response_type == "OFF" && "dsi_off_pref_dir" %in% names(tracker)) tracker$dsi_off_pref_dir[i] <- pref_dir_deg

      ###########

      message(paste("Plotting polar plot for", data_filename, "Experiment", experiment_number, "Row", i, "Response:", response_type))


    tryCatch({

  R_max <- 100  # Radius = 100 Hz, 1.0 DSI

  # If tuning is too weak, mark DS as NULL and do not plot
  if (max(ordered_avg_frequencies$MeanFrequency, na.rm = TRUE) < 15) {

    if (response_type == "ON") {
      tracker$dsi_on[i]   <- NA
      tracker$is_DS_ON[i] <- NA
    } else {
      tracker$dsi_off[i]   <- NA
      tracker$is_DS_OFF[i] <- NA
    }

    message("Skipping plot + setting DS NULL (<5 Hz): ", data_filename, " ", response_type)
    next
  }

  DSI_to_plot <- ifelse(response_type == "ON", tracker$dsi_on[i], tracker$dsi_off[i])
  pref_to_plot <- pref_dir_deg  # from your vector-sum block

  plot_df <- ordered_avg_frequencies %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Angle), !is.na(MeanFrequency)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Angle = as.numeric(Angle) %% 360,
      MeanFrequency = pmax(0, MeanFrequency)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Angle)

  # --- TRUE closure for polygon: append first point at Angle + 360 ---
  first_pt <- plot_df[1, ]
  first_pt$Angle <- first_pt$Angle + 360
  plot_df_closed <- dplyr::bind_rows(plot_df, first_pt)

  # DSI vector scaled into Hz space (1.0 DSI = 100 Hz)
  dsi_len_hz <- DSI_to_plot * R_max
  dsi_df <- data.frame(
    Angle = (pref_to_plot %% 360),
    r0 = 0,
    r1 = dsi_len_hz
  )

  polar_plot <- ggplot() +
    # polygon outline (now it will actually close)
    geom_path(
      data = plot_df_closed,
      aes(x = Angle, y = MeanFrequency, group = 1),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1.3,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df,
      aes(x = Angle, y = MeanFrequency),
      size = 2.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    # DSI vector line (only if DSI is not NA)
    geom_segment(
      data = dsi_df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(r1)),
      aes(x = Angle, xend = Angle, y = r0, yend = r1),
      linewidth = 1.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    coord_polar(start = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 330, by = 30),
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "°"),
      limits = c(0, 360)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, R_max),
      breaks = c(0, 50, 100)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(response_type, "  DSI = ", sprintf("%.2f", DSI_to_plot)),
      x = "",
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  plot_title <- paste("polarplot", response_type, data_filename, experiment_number, sep = "_")
  full_filename <- paste0(plot_title, ".png")
  ggsave(full_filename, plot = polar_plot,
         path = save_paths[["ds"]],
         width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

}, error = function(e) {
  message("Error in plotting for file:", data_filename, " Experiment:", experiment_number, " Response:", response_type)
  message("Error message:", e$message)
})



    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# HELPERS
# =========================================================
safe_pmin2 <- function(x, y) {
  out <- pmin(x, y, na.rm = TRUE)
  out[is.infinite(out)] <- NA_real_
  out
}

sig_label <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 1e-4 ~ "****",
    p < 1e-3 ~ "***",
    p < 1e-2 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

build_paired_onoff <- function(df, metric_name, on_col, off_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(group %in% onoff_groups) %>%
    transmute(
      group,
      metric = metric_name,
      value_on = .data[[on_col]],
      value_off = .data[[off_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value_on), !is.na(value_off))
}

build_group_metric <- function(df, metric_name, on_col, off_col, collapse_lookup_df) {
  df %>%
    left_join(
      collapse_lookup_df %>% filter(metric == metric_name),
      by = "group"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      group,
      metric = metric_name,
      value = case_when(
        classification == "ON" ~ .data[[on_col]],
        classification == "OFF" ~ .data[[off_col]],
        classification == "ON-OFF" ~ .data[[on_col]],
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      collapse_to_on
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
}

# =========================================================
# OUTLIER FILTERING (IQR RULE)
# EXEMPT METRICS: dsi, os_index
# =========================================================
remove_outliers_iqr_group_metric <- function(df, exempt_metrics = c("dsi", "os_index")) {
  df %>%
    group_by(metric, group) %>%
    mutate(
      Q1 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR_val = IQR(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val,
      upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val,
      keep = case_when(
        metric %in% exempt_metrics ~ TRUE,
        is.na(value) ~ FALSE,
        IQR_val == 0 ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ value >= lower & value <= upper
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

remove_outliers_iqr_paired <- function(df_long, exempt_metrics = c("dsi", "os_index")) {
  df_long %>%
    group_by(metric, group, polarity) %>%
    mutate(
      Q1 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR_val = IQR(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val,
      upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val,
      keep = case_when(
        metric %in% exempt_metrics ~ TRUE,
        is.na(value) ~ FALSE,
        IQR_val == 0 ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ value >= lower & value <= upper
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

plot_metric_groups <- function(df_long,
                               metric_name,
                               y_label,
                               out_dir,
                               file_stub = metric_name,
                               y_limits = NULL,
                               y_breaks = NULL) {

  d <- df_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group_order))

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(color = group),
      fill = "white",
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 1.25,
      width = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(fill = group),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      size = 2.2,
      stroke = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.85,
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )

  if (!is.null(y_breaks)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks)
  }

  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits, clip = "off")
  } else {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  }

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, ".pdf"),
    plot = p,
    path = out_dir,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    device = "pdf"
  )

  invisible(p)
}

plot_paired_onoff_metric <- function(df_paired_wide,
                                     metric_name,
                                     onoff_group,
                                     y_label,
                                     out_dir,
                                     paired_results,
                                     file_stub = paste0(metric_name, "_", onoff_group, "_onoff_paired"),
                                     y_limits = NULL,
                                     y_breaks = NULL) {

  d_wide <- df_paired_wide %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name, group == onoff_group) %>%
    mutate(cell_id = row_number())

  if (nrow(d_wide) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  d_long <- d_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(value_on, value_off),
      names_to = "polarity",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      polarity = recode(polarity, value_on = "ON", value_off = "OFF"),
      polarity = factor(polarity, levels = c("ON", "OFF"))
    )

  pval_row <- paired_results %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name, group == onoff_group)

  p_text <- if (nrow(pval_row) == 1 && !is.na(pval_row$p)) {
    paste0("paired Wilcoxon: p = ", signif(pval_row$p, 3), " (", pval_row$p_signif, ")")
  } else {
    "paired Wilcoxon: NA"
  }

  p <- ggplot(d_long, aes(x = polarity, y = value, group = cell_id)) +
    geom_line(
      color = "grey65",
      alpha = 0.7,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = polarity),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      size = 2.8,
      stroke = 0.9
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = 1),
      fun = median,
      geom = "crossbar",
      width = 0.45,
      fatten = 0,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("ON" = "white", "OFF" = "grey70")) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label,
      subtitle = p_text
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )

  if (!is.null(y_breaks)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks)
  }

  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)
  }

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, ".pdf"),
    plot = p,
    path = out_dir,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    device = "pdf"
  )

  invisible(p)
}

plot_metric_heatmap <- function(pairwise_df,
                                metric_name,
                                out_dir,
                                file_stub = paste0(metric_name, "_heatmap")) {

  heatmap_data <- pairwise_df %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    select(group1, group2, p.adj)

  if (nrow(heatmap_data) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  heatmap_data_sym <- bind_rows(
    heatmap_data,
    heatmap_data %>% rename(group1 = group2, group2 = group1)
  )

  diag_data <- tibble(
    group1 = group_order,
    group2 = group_order,
    p.adj = 1
  )

  heatmap_data_sym <- bind_rows(heatmap_data_sym, diag_data) %>%
    distinct(group1, group2, .keep_all = TRUE)

  heatmap_long <- heatmap_data_sym %>%
    mutate(
      group1 = factor(group1, levels = group_order),
      group2 = factor(group2, levels = group_order),
      significance = case_when(
        p.adj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p.adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
        p.adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
        p.adj < 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE           ~ ""
      ),
      sig_bin = case_when(
        p.adj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p.adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
        p.adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
        p.adj < 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE           ~ "ns"
      ),
      sig_bin = factor(sig_bin, levels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
    ) %>%
    filter(as.numeric(group1) >= as.numeric(group2)) %>%
    mutate(group1 = fct_rev(group1))

  heatplot <- ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = group1, y = group2, fill = sig_bin)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = significance), color = "white", size = 5) +
    theme_void() +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sig_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "left")

  print(heatplot)

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, ".pdf"),
    plot = heatplot,
    path = out_dir,
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    device = "pdf"
  )

  invisible(heatplot)
}

# =========================================================
# 1) PAIRED ON vs OFF TESTS WITHIN EACH ON-OFF GROUP
# =========================================================
paired_specs <- tribble(
  ~metric,               ~on_col,        ~off_col,       ~label,
  "baseline_rate_hz",    "on_baseline",  "off_baseline", "Baseline Firing Rate (Hz)",
  "dsi",                 "dsi_on",       "dsi_off",      "Direction Selectivity Index",
  "fp_index",            "on_fp_index",  "off_fp_index", "Final/Peak Index",
  "peak_firing_rate_hz", "on_peak",      "off_peak",     "Peak Firing Rate (Hz)"
)

paired_onoff_long <- pmap_dfr(
  paired_specs,
  function(metric, on_col, off_col, label) {
    build_paired_onoff(tracker_plot, metric, on_col, off_col)
  }
)

write.csv(
  paired_onoff_long,
  file.path(save_feature, "onoff_paired_long_raw.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

paired_results <- pmap_dfr(
  paired_specs,
  function(metric, on_col, off_col, label) {
    map_dfr(onoff_groups, function(g) {
      test_df <- tracker_plot %>%
        filter(group == g) %>%
        transmute(
          value_on = .data[[on_col]],
          value_off = .data[[off_col]]
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(value_on), !is.na(value_off))

      n_cells <- nrow(test_df)

      if (n_cells >= 2) {
        w <- wilcox.test(test_df$value_on, test_df$value_off, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
        p_val <- w$p.value
      } else {
        p_val <- NA_real_
      }

      tibble(
        group = g,
        metric = metric,
        label = label,
        n = n_cells,
        p = p_val,
        p_signif = sig_label(p_val),
        collapse_to_on = if_else(!is.na(p_val) & p_val >= 0.05, TRUE, FALSE)
      )
    })
  }
)

write.csv(
  paired_results,
  file.path(save_feature, "onoff_paired_wilcox_results_by_group.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

  tracker_plot %>%

) %>%
  mutate(

      levels = c(

      )
    )
  )

write.csv(

# =========================================================
# 3) FILTER OUTLIERS FOR PLOTTING
# =========================================================
group_metrics_flagged <- remove_outliers_iqr_group_metric(group_metrics_long)

group_metrics_long_filtered <- group_metrics_flagged %>%
  filter(keep) %>%
  select(group, metric, value)

paired_onoff_long_for_filter <- paired_onoff_long %>%
  group_by(metric, group) %>%
  mutate(cell_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(value_on, value_off),

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    polarity = recode(polarity_raw, value_on = "ON", value_off = "OFF")
  ) %>%
  select(cell_id, metric, group, polarity, value)

paired_onoff_flagged <- remove_outliers_iqr_paired(paired_onoff_long_for_filter)

paired_onoff_long_filtered <- paired_onoff_flagged %>%
  filter(keep) %>%
  select(cell_id, metric, group, polarity, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = polarity, values_from = value, names_prefix = "value_") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value_ON), !is.na(value_OFF)) %>%
  rename(
    value_on = value_ON,
    value_off = value_OFF
  )

paired_onoff_removed_outliers <- paired_onoff_flagged %>%
  filter(!keep) %>%
  select(cell_id, metric, group, polarity, value)

write.csv(
  paired_onoff_long_filtered,
  file.path(save_feature, "onoff_paired_filtered_for_plotting.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  paired_onoff_removed_outliers,
  file.path(save_feature, "onoff_paired_removed_outliers.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# =========================================================
# 4) SUMMARY TABLES (RAW DATA FOR STATS)
# =========================================================
metric_group_summary_mean_sem <- group_metrics_long %>%
  group_by(metric, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  metric_group_summary_mean_sem,
  file.path(save_feature, "metric_group_summary_mean_sem.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

metric_group_summary_median_iqr <- group_metrics_long %>%
  group_by(metric, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = IQR(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  metric_group_summary_median_iqr,
  file.path(save_feature, "metric_group_summary_median_iqr.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

metric_group_summary_combined <- metric_group_summary_mean_sem %>%
  left_join(metric_group_summary_median_iqr, by = c("metric", "group", "n")) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_sem = paste0(round(mean, 2), " ± ", round(sem, 2)),
    median_iqr = paste0(round(median, 2), " (", round(q1, 2), "-", round(q3, 2), ")")
  ) %>%
  select(metric, group, n, mean_sem, median_iqr, mean, sem, median, q1, q3, iqr)

write.csv(
  metric_group_summary_combined,
  file.path(save_feature, "metric_group_summary_combined.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# =========================================================
# CHECK ASSUMPTIONS AND RECOMMEND TEST FOR EACH METRIC
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

test_summary <- tibble(
  metric = character(),
  number_of_groups = integer(),
  min_group_n = integer(),
  all_groups_normal = logical(),
  levene_p = numeric(),
  recommended_test = character(),
  recommended_posthoc = character()
)

normality_summary <- tibble()

metrics <- unique(as.character(group_metrics_long$metric))

for (metric_name in metrics) {

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Checking:", metric_name, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")

  filtered_data <- group_metrics_long %>%
    filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      !is.na(value),
      !is.na(group)
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    cat("No data available for", metric_name, "\n")
    next
  }

  group_sizes <- filtered_data %>%
    count(group, name = "n")

  n_groups <- n_distinct(filtered_data$group)
  min_group_n <- min(group_sizes$n)

  print(group_sizes)

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Shapiro-Wilk test within each group
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  metric_normality <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      shapiro_p = case_when(
        n() < 3 ~ NA_real_,
        n_distinct(value) < 2 ~ NA_real_,
        n() > 5000 ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ tryCatch(
          shapiro.test(value)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(metric = metric_name) %>%
    select(metric, everything())

  print(metric_normality)

  normality_summary <- bind_rows(
    normality_summary,
    metric_normality
  )

  valid_shapiro <- metric_normality$shapiro_p[
    !is.na(metric_normality$shapiro_p)
  ]

  # Require every included group to have a valid Shapiro result
  # and every valid result to have p > 0.05
  all_groups_have_shapiro <-
    length(valid_shapiro) == n_groups

  is_normal <-
    all_groups_have_shapiro &&
    all(valid_shapiro > 0.05)

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Levene's test for equality of variances
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  levene_result <- tryCatch(
    filtered_data %>%
      levene_test(value ~ group),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  levene_p <- if (!is.null(levene_result)) {
    levene_result$p
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  if (!is.null(levene_result)) {
    print(levene_result)
  } else {
    cat("Levene's test could not be calculated.\n")
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Select overall and post hoc tests
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is_normal) {

    if (n_groups == 2) {
      recommended_test <- "Wilcoxon rank-sum test"
      recommended_posthoc <- "None: only two groups"
    } else {
      recommended_test <- "Kruskal-Wallis"
      recommended_posthoc <- "Dunn's test with BH correction"
    }

  } else if (!is.na(levene_p) && levene_p > 0.05) {

    if (n_groups == 2) {
      recommended_test <- "Student's two-sample t-test"
      recommended_posthoc <- "None: only two groups"
    } else {
      recommended_test <- "One-way ANOVA"
      recommended_posthoc <- "Tukey HSD"
    }

  } else {

    if (n_groups == 2) {
      recommended_test <- "Welch's two-sample t-test"
      recommended_posthoc <- "None: only two groups"
    } else {
      recommended_test <- "Welch's ANOVA"
      recommended_posthoc <- "Games-Howell"
    }
  }

  cat(
    "\n→ Use: ", recommended_test,
    "\n→ Follow-up: ", recommended_posthoc,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  test_summary <- bind_rows(
    test_summary,
    tibble(
      metric = metric_name,
      number_of_groups = n_groups,
      min_group_n = min_group_n,
      all_groups_normal = is_normal,
      levene_p = levene_p,
      recommended_test = recommended_test,
      recommended_posthoc = recommended_posthoc
    )
  )
}

write.csv(
  normality_summary,
  file.path(
    save_feature,
    "metric_group_shapiro_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  test_summary,
  file.path(
    save_feature,
    "Statistical_Test_Recommendations.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

test_summary

# =========================================================
# 5) ACROSS-GROUP STATS (RAW DATA)
# Kruskal-Wallis followed by Dunn's test with BH correction
# =========================================================

overall_stats <- group_metrics_long %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  kruskal_test(value ~ group) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_signif = sig_label(p)
  )

write.csv(
  overall_stats,
  file.path(
    save_feature,
    "overall_metric_kruskal_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Dunn's post hoc test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction
pairwise_stats <- group_metrics_long %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  dunn_test(
    value ~ group,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj.signif = sig_label(p.adj)
  )

write.csv(
  pairwise_stats,
  file.path(
    save_feature,
    "pairwise_metric_dunn_BH_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
